title: Collect the Names
goal: Collect everyone's name into a list. Decide whether the strings are borrowed or copied.
hints: The names already exist inside the users. A Vec<&str> is a list of views - no new strings at all.
Lifetime elision ties the returned borrows to the input slice automatically - one input, no annotations needed.
explanation: Vec<&str> collects VIEWS into strings the caller already owns: zero allocations beyond the Vec itself, and elision handles the lifetimes (single borrowed input → output tied to it). Cloning each name costs one String per user - sometimes right, when the caller must outlive the users. The double-map version clones twice per element, which is never right. The collect target type is the API decision.
